meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取仓库里全部 open 的 issue 和 PR,每条各起一个后台任务做分析,把带 GitHub 永久链接证据的报告写进 /tmp/{时间戳}/ 下的文件;它不在 GitHub 上做任何改动。
howto.when: 当你提到 “triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs” 等关键词,或要求对仓库的 open issue/PR 做只读分类与证据分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我 triage 这个仓库的 issues
say.note: 每条 issue 生成一份报告文件
逐个 PR 出分析报告,不改动 GitHub

say.text: 对这个仓库跑一遍 github triage
say.note: 所有 open 条目都会被分析

howto.what_en: Claude reads all open issues and PRs, spawns one background task per item, and writes reports backed by GitHub permalinks into /tmp/{datetime}/. It takes no action on GitHub — no comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage', or when you ask for a read-only breakdown of the repo's open items.

say_en.text: Triage the open issues in this repo

say_en.note: Analyzes each PR, no GitHub changes

say_en.text: Run github triage on this repo
